focus.name: interaction-spawn-type1d-type1e-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the confirmed upper-route Type-0x1D gate and direct Type-0x1E interaction creators to selector-qualified stable identities.

contracts: INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE entry 0x42E8 selects selector 0x65 and the Type-0x1D gate body at 0x001B6E70.
The selector-0x65 body enters LevelObjectSpawnEntry only when INTERACTION_GATE_TYPE1D is nonzero.
INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE entry 0x4198 selects selector 0x11 and the direct Type-0x1E body at 0x001B6E90.
The selector-0x11 body loads ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_1E at 0x001B7C24 and enters LevelObjectSpawnEntry directly; it bypasses the adjacent selector-0x64 gate wrapper at 0x001B6E86.
limitations: The names identify the confirmed runtime-template and gate contracts, not user-facing scene roles.
The Type-0x1D template's runtime conversion to Type-0x20 occurs in the adjacent upper actor path and is not assigned to this gate body's name.
Dynamic reachability outside the recorded upper-route trace remains unresolved.
